scripts.check: pnpm -C web lint && pnpm -C web typecheck && pnpm -C web test && pnpm lint:api && pnpm typecheck:api && uv run --directory api pytest -q
scripts.test:web: pnpm -C web lint && pnpm -C web typecheck && pnpm -C web test && pnpm -C web build
scripts.test:api: pnpm lint:api && pnpm typecheck:api && uv run --directory api pytest
scripts.lint:api: uv run --directory api ruff check src tests ../benchmarks
scripts.format:api: uv run --directory api ruff format src tests ../benchmarks
scripts.bench: pnpm -C web build && uv run --directory api python ../benchmarks/bench.py --label latest --ui
